issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for PersonService.getAllPersons: The Problem Statement (Part 3) and the template declare/expect a service method that accepts a PersonSortingOptions parameter so sorting can be applied (see problem_statement.md and template PersonService). The template defines: public List<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions). However, in the solution repository PersonResource invokes personService.getAllPersons(new PersonSortingOptions(...)) while the solution repository's PersonService only provides a no-argument method public List<Person> getAllPersons(). This inconsistency (parameterized signature vs. no-arg signature) will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the correct API to implement for sorting.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the service API consistent with the problem statement and the controller: add/restore a method in PersonService with the signature public List<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions) and implement the sorting logic there (honoring SortField and SortingOrder). Alternatively, change PersonResource to call the existing no-arg method and update the problem statement/template — but prefer adding the parameterized method so the template, problem statement, and client/server code align and students can implement the sorting feature as described.
